ABOUT

the Practice

At Family Dental Care in West Palm Beach, Florida, an experienced and compassionate team led by Michael C. Westcott, DDS, and Sujay Trivedi, DMD, provide integrative and multidisciplinary dental care for patients ages eight and up at a state-of-the-art facility.

The team is committed to solving dental problems with comprehensive general dentistry and cosmetic dentistry services. Whether a patient has just started seeing the dentist for their first teeth cleaning or is in need of a full set of [dentures](https://www.familydentalcare561.com/services/dentures), Family Dental Care is ready to help.

Family Dental Care is a one-stop shop for dental needs with the experienced team of dentists bringing a wide range of dentistry skills and experience to the practice, from general dentistry to cosmetic dentistry.

Individuals receive comprehensive dental care for routine dentistry and [teeth cleanings](https://www.familydentalcare561.com/services/teeth-cleaning), [crowns and bridges](https://www.familydentalcare561.com/services/crowns-and-bridges), restorative dentistry services, [emergency dentistry](https://www.familydentalcare561.com/services/emergency-dentistry), and cosmetic dentistry, including [smile makeovers](https://www.familydentalcare561.com/services/smile-makeover), veneers, and teeth whitening all under one roof.

The fully equipped modern dental practice offers exceptional dental treatments and takes care to ensure the comfort of everyone.

To schedule an appointment with the team at Family Dental Care, call the practice or use the convenient online booking tool.

# Towncare Dental of Forest Hill, your experienced dentists in West Palm Beach

Since 2001, our multi-specialty practice has provided a full range of dental care for both adults and children, beginning at the age of five. Our numerous dental services include general dentistry, cosmetic dentistry, periodontal care, braces, oral surgery, and sedation dentistry. Our variety of family dental care treatments allows us to serve as a full-service local dentist office in West Palm Beach. We’re close to public transportation at 3027 Forest Hill Boulevard, Suite A3, West Palm Beach, FL 33406.

You’ll find us west of I-95 in the Forest Hill Center, behind 7-Eleven. We’re open for appointments on Monday through Friday from 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. We also accept walk-in patients and dental emergencies, reserving time in the schedule to ensure that waiting time is kept to a minimum. Our friendly bilingual staff speaks English and Spanish to ease communication with more residents in the community.

Our practice has become known for providing high-quality dentistry from very caring West Palm Beach dentists. We treat every patient like family and provide excellent customer service with a caring, personal touch. Our number one priority is the well-being of our patients. We always take our time with every patient and respect their personal needs to ensure that they have a satisfying dental care experience.

Our staff also takes pride in helping the [West Palm Beach community](https://www.towncaredental.com/dentist-office/west-palm-beach-fl-33406/west-palm-beach-community) through our support of the Make-A-Wish Foundation, Forest Hills High School, and the Girl Scouts. We invite your entire family to come discover the difference of Towncare Dental of Forest Hill. _Call us today at [(561) 459-1488](tel:+15614591488) or [book an appointment online](https://www.towncaredental.com/dentist-office/west-palm-beach-fl-33406/dental-appointments-near-me)._

## Looking for Affordable Family Dental Care in West Palm Beach?

Towncare Dental of Forest Hill has been trusted by local families for the last 25 years. Our experienced West Palm Beach dentists offer many dental specialties to meet the many needs of the family. We provide the general dentistry services of check-ups, cleanings, x-rays, oral cancer screenings, tooth-colored fillings, composite bonding, crowns, bridges, and dentures, including Renaissance custom dentures and partials. Our cosmetic dental services include porcelain veneers, Lumineers®, dental implants, and both at-home and in-office teeth whitening. Our on-site periodontist treats all levels of gum disease, while our endodontist gently handles root canals, and our oral surgeon is highly skilled with dental implants and advanced cases. We also offer orthodontics like Invisalign® invisible braces, as well as anxiety-easing sedation dentistry for patients who experience fear about dental care.

## Exceptional Dental Care That Suits Any Budget

Since many patients express concern about dental care costs, Towncare Dental of Forest Hill offers affordable ways to ease the payment process. Along with accepting most dental insurance plans, we take Smile Alliance Club, offer special financing options, and feature cost-saving deals and discounts on many common dental services. _Call us at [(561) 459-1488](tel:+15614591488) today to schedule your appointment or [book an appointment online](https://www.towncaredental.com/dentist-office/west-palm-beach-fl-33406/dental-appointments-near-me)._

# Stress-Free Oral & Maxillofacial Surgery in West Palm Beach.

#### South Florida’s premier location for [wisdom teeth removal](https://www.wpboms.com/wisdom-teeth-removal), [dental implants](https://www.wpboms.com/dental-implants), [maxillofacial trauma surgery](https://www.wpboms.com/maxillofacial-trauma), [sedation dentistry](https://www.wpboms.com/sedation-dentistry), and more.

## Prioritizing quality, comfort, and ease.

At West Palm Beach Oral & Maxillofacial Surgery, we are committed to providing the highest quality concierge care in a warm and peaceful environment. Whether you need [wisdom teeth removal](https://www.wpboms.com/wisdom-teeth-removal), [dental implants](https://www.wpboms.com/dental-implants), [sedation dentistry](https://www.wpboms.com/sedation-dentistry), or [advanced corrective surgeries](https://www.wpboms.com/maxillofacial-trauma), we employ the latest state-of-the-art technologies and procedures to ensure you receive exceptional treatment and feel comfortable and informed throughout your entire treatment journey.

[Learn more](https://www.wpboms.com/services)

![](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/65b946286edd8d5209314503/ae4fb650-ecfb-4e33-9a43-2231aaba5c29/pexels-shiny-diamond-3762408.jpeg)

- Wisdom Teeth Removal




















We have years of experience in removing wisdom teeth using advanced techniques and premium equipment. We will thoroughly evaluate your condition, including the position and growth pattern of your wisdom teeth, to determine if extraction is necessary. If it is, we will create a personalized treatment plan tailored to your specific needs.



[Learn more](https://www.wpboms.com/wisdom-teeth-removal)

- Dental Implants




















We offer an array of dental implant options, each providing a long-lasting solution for missing teeth that is expertly crafted to seamlessly blend with your natural smile.



[Learn more](https://www.wpboms.com/dental-implants)

- Sedation Dentistry




















We understand that dental procedures can be an anxiety-inducing experience for many individuals. For those who prefer to be sedated while undergoing dental procedures, we offer sedation options to help patients relax and feel more comfortable. These sedation options include Local Anesthetic, Nitrous Oxide Dental Sedation, General Anesthesia, IV sedation, and Exparel® Opioid-Free Anesthesia. We will discuss these options prior to your procedure to determine a solution that best fits your needs.



[Learn more](https://www.wpboms.com/sedation-dentistry)

- Oral Pathology




















Routine oral cancer screenings play an essential role in detecting and addressing oral pathologies at their earliest stages. If you notice any unusual lumps or sores in your mouth, take notice — they could be telling you something important about your health and flagging early signs of trouble. We perform diagnostic biopsies to identify and treat these pathologies as early as possible, providing the benefit of early detection and treatment.



[Learn more](https://www.wpboms.com/oral-pathology)

- Maxillofacial Trauma




















In the wake of an injury, maxillofacial trauma can be a distressing and complex issue to navigate. Dr. Ducharme can help address complex facial injuries and restore not just the function but also the aesthetics of a patient's face. Whether it’s soft tissue injuries, tooth injuries, broken facial bones, or a fractured jaw, Dr. Ducharme approaches each case with a deep understanding of how the maxilla—or upper jawbone—interplays with critical structures like the nose and eye sockets to shape one's unique appearance.



[Learn more](https://www.wpboms.com/maxillofacial-trauma)

- Bone Grafting




















Bone grafting is an advanced and highly beneficial surgical procedure that confers a wealth of advantages for patients with dental health needs. We are experts in restoring and enhancing bone structure to support dental implants—providing a stable and lasting foundation for those with inadequate bone mass.

- Expose and Bond




















We specialize in the precise and careful execution of the Expose and Bond procedure, an essential technique to assist in the alignment and eruption of impacted teeth, including wisdom teeth. Our skilled oral surgeon delicately exposes the impacted tooth that resides beneath the gum line or bone, and then applies a small orthodontic bonding attachment that guides the tooth to its proper place.

- EXPAREL




















At our practice, we prioritize the comfort and safety of our patients, especially in pain management following surgical procedures. That's why we offer EXPAREL – a revolutionary, long-lasting, non-opioid pain reliever specifically designed to minimize discomfort in the crucial first 72 hours post-surgery.


![](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/65b946286edd8d5209314503/d5dd296e-a92d-45a2-93a3-59059aa8e466/palmbeach.jpeg)

## About Our Practice

Our team, led by Board-Certified Oral and Maxillofacial Surgeon [Dr. Monika Ducharme](https://www.wpboms.com/about), brings a level of expertise and compassion that is unmatched. Our practice utilizes the latest advancements in technology to ensure our patients receive the most effective and efficient care possible. Above all, we truly value every one of our patients and are committed to their comfort and care. West Palm Beach Oral & Maxillofacial Surgery is more than just a destination for surgical excellence; it is a sanctuary where patients receive quality and compassionate care.

### Meet Dr. Ducharme

Dr. Monika Ducharme is a Board-Certified Oral and Maxillofacial Surgeon and the lead surgeon at West Palm Beach Oral & Maxillofacial Surgery.

Dr. Ducharme graduated at the top of her class from the University of Southern California's prestigious Herman Ostrow School of Dentistry. During her residency at the renowned Jackson Memorial Hospital, affiliated with the University of Miami, Dr. Ducharme was recognized as the Resident of the Year and also received the Outstanding Patient Care Award, nominated by her attending physicians during her pivotal Chief year.

As the lead surgeon at West Palm Beach Oral & Maxillofacial Surgery, Dr. Ducharme uses her expertise to offer a comprehensive range of services, from corrective surgeries to dental implants and wisdom teeth removal.

Most importantly, Dr. Ducharme is known for her empathetic and warm approach to patient care and goes above and beyond to make sure her patients feel informed, comfortable, and empowered.

![](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/65b946286edd8d5209314503/a460f8ae-3167-49ce-9db8-4f922915564b/Dr.+Monika+Ducharme)

![](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/65b946286edd8d5209314503/2e1c8bad-4629-484b-8e29-2112f3f96b8c/palm+beach.jpeg)

### Frequently Asked Questions

- Do you accept insurance?




















Yes, we do accept several insurance plans for our oral surgery procedures. We understand that navigating insurance can be confusing and overwhelming, so we are here to help. Our team is knowledgeable about various insurance plans and can assist you in understanding your coverage and benefits.



[Contact Us](https://www.wpboms.com/contact)

- How are Oral Surgeons and Dentists different?




















Oral surgeons and dentists are both dental professionals who specialize in the care and treatment of teeth, gums, and other oral structures. However, their roles and responsibilities may differ.



Dentists typically focus on general oral health care, such as routine cleanings, fillings, and root canals. They also provide cosmetic treatments like teeth whitening or veneers. On the other hand, oral surgeons are specialists who have completed additional training and education in surgical procedures involving the mouth, jaw, and face. This may include wisdom teeth extraction, dental implant placement, and corrective jaw surgery.



To become a general dentist, one needs to finish a four-year dental program at a university. However, becoming a board-certified oral surgeon requires an additional three to four years of specialized training specifically in oral and maxillofacial surgery. This equips them with expert skills and knowledge in procedures such as extractions and implant placement, which a general dentist may not have.

- Is Oral Surgery painful?




















Understandably, the thought of undergoing oral surgery may cause some anxiety and concern about pain. However, thanks to modern advancements in pain relief and dental sedation techniques, oral surgery is typically not painful. During the procedure, you will likely be under sedation or anesthesia, so you won't feel any discomfort. Afterward, you may experience some minor discomfort or swelling, but this can easily be managed with prescribed pain medication and cold compresses. Our team will make sure you are as comfortable as possible throughout the entire process. So don't let fear of pain hold you back from getting the dental care you need - we are here to help alleviate any concerns and ensure a positive experience for our patients. So if you have been putting off necessary oral surgery, don't hesitate to schedule a consultation with us today.

- When do Wisdom Teeth need to be removed?




















Everyone's experience with wisdom teeth is unique. Many people need to have them removed, but sometimes they come in without causing any problems. The key is to keep up with regular dental checkups. Your dentist will monitor your wisdom teeth and if any issues are spotted, they'll refer you to us. We'll handle the situation before it escalates into a bigger problem.

- Will you guide me on what to do before and after surgery?




















Of course! Before your surgery, we will provide you with detailed instructions on how to prepare for the procedure. This may include fasting for a certain amount of time or avoiding certain medications. After surgery, we will also give you specific guidelines on how to care for yourself at home. This may include taking prescribed medication, using cold compresses to reduce swelling, and changing your diet to softer foods. It's important to follow these instructions carefully for a smooth and speedy recovery. You can always reach out to us with any questions or concerns you may have along the way. Our team is here to support you every step of the way.

- Do I need someone to join me at my appointment?




















It is recommended to have someone accompany you to your appointment, especially if you will be under sedation or anesthesia. This person can assist you after the procedure and drive you home safely. If this is not possible, please make sure to arrange for transportation beforehand as it is not safe for you to drive yourself while still under the effects of sedation. Safety is our top priority, so we always advise having someone with you during and after your oral surgery appointment.



Our team will also be available to answer any questions or concerns you may have before, during, and after the procedure. We want to make sure you feel fully supported and at ease throughout the entire process.

- Additional Questions?




















Feel free to reach out to our team!



[Contact Us](https://www.wpboms.com/contact)

## West Palm Beach & Juno Beach _Cosmetic Dentistry_

**We would like to welcome you to our family.** We want to thank you for choosing us to care for all your cosmetic dentistry, sedation dentistry, general dentistry, and dental implants needs. Our goal is for you to attain optimal oral health and to maintain a beautiful healthy smile.

We are committed to our patients, and to their need to find a **West Palm Beach & Juno Beach cosmetic dentistry**, general dentistry, or sedation dentistry doctor who can help them to reach their goals and achieve their expectations in the most experienced and professional manner.

## OFFICIAL DENTAL OFFICE FOR  **THE WASHINGTON NATIONALS BASEBALL TEAM**

![Washington Nationals Logo](https://www.weinbergdentistry.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/Washington_Nationals_logo-300x300-1.png)

## Cosmetic Dentistry

Our approach to cosmetic dentistry at Weinberg Dentistry in West Palm Beach and Juno Beach, involves conservative cosmetic dentistry methods that preserve as much of your natural tooth structure as possible. We achieve this through cosmetic dentistry procedures that require minimal dental visits such as porcelain veneers, dental crowns, dental implants, teeth whitening, root canals and CEREC one-visit crowns.

We want you to be pleased with your results, so we offer a free consultation and cover the cosmetic dentistry options available to you. With our cosmetic dentistry offices in West Palm Beach and Juno Beach, we can partner with you to create a beautiful custom smile to last a lifetime!

[Learn **More**](https://www.weinbergdentistry.com/cosmetic-dentistry/)

## Dental Implants

In the past having a missing tooth left people with few options, and it could often be a source of physical and social discomfort. Now with dental implants, we can replace missing teeth safely and permanently! This innovative dental technology is designed to be a durable, long lasting solution for those with one or more missing teeth.

It can also be used in conjunction with a dental crown to replace a single missing tooth or act as anchoring points for a permanent denture solution to replace multiple teeth. Come on in today to find out more about this wonderful tooth replacement solution!

[Learn **More**](https://www.weinbergdentistry.com/dental-implants-west-palm-beach/)

## Sedation Dentistry

Nearly 30–50% of Americans suffer from dental phobia, and because of that, they avoid necessary treatment. Now, with our sedation dentistry offices in West Palm Beach and Juno Beach, there is a way that you can have your treatment completed in minimal visits, with no pain and little memory of the experience.

As a trained, experienced sedation dentistry doctor, Dr. Weinberg has helped countless patients with their fear of going to the dentist. Sedation dentistry can truly help you feel relaxed and comfortable while you receive your dental procedures at Weinberg Dentistry. With our sedation dentistry services, you never have to be afraid of the dentist ever again.

[Learn **More**](https://www.weinbergdentistry.com/sedation-dentistry/)

## General Dentistry

If you are looking for a general dentistry doctor near West Palm Beach or Juno Beach you can trust, look no further. We offer a wide variety of general dentistry treatments, including: dental checkups, gentle cleaning, deep scaling, and root planing, dental sealants, oral cancer screenings, and other general dentistry procedures that can give you a clean, healthy, and beautiful smile.

We want your smile to be the best it can be—that includes preventing dental damage before it happens. With general dentistry procedures and regular dental cleanings, we can give you long-lasting oral health.

[Learn **More**](https://www.weinbergdentistry.com/general-dentistry/)
